item.title: Shuukatsu!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Cacao
  • 発売日: 2017-12-22
  • スコア: 6.8/10 (30 人評価)
  • 日本語名: シューカツ！
  • 英語名: Shuukatsu!

别名

  • Shuugaku Ryokou de Harem

あらすじ

The protagonist, due to his fear of young girls, aims to be an all-boys school’s teacher. But because one of his relatives’ recommendation he is assigned to an all-girls school instead. However, he becomes quite popular in the class.

At his school, there is a legend among the students. If two people manages to do the business on the field trip, they will be happy together forever. And there’re several girls who are interested in the protagonist.

item.title: Boin ni Kakero!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Cacao
  • 発売日: 2006-07-21
  • スコア: 7.2700000000000005/10 (26 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ボインにかけろ!
  • 英語名: Boin ni Kakero!

あらすじ

Kazuki is a high school student who likes big breasts. His parents are abroad on business and he is living alone. One day, when he comes back home, he finds his home is on fire. His parents on abroad tells him to stay at his relative’s hotel and he goes there. When he arrives, he can’t believe his eyes because all the women working at the hotel are beautiful and have big breasts. Moreover, there are beautiful Miko sisters at nearby shrine and a uni student with blond hair staying at the hotel. His new and wonderful life at the hotel starts!
